import sys
import heapq

def dijkstra(graph, start, n):
    distances = [float('inf')] * (n + 1)
    distances[start] = 0
    priority_queue = [(0, start)]
    paths = {start: set()}
    
    while priority_queue:

            continue

                distances[neighbor] = distance
                paths[neighbor] = set(paths[current_node])
                paths[neighbor].add((current_node, neighbor))

            elif distance == distances[neighbor]:
                paths[neighbor].update(paths[current_node])
                paths[neighbor].add((current_node, neighbor))
    
    return paths
